caveats: Google ratings could not be read directly (Google served a bot check); ratings quoted come from directory pages (Birdeye, Angi search summaries) or the businesses' own sites, and those pages often blocked me.
Angi, HomeAdvisor, Yellow Pages, BBB and Manta returned 403/Cloudflare blocks, so review counts for the five businesses without websites are unconfirmed.
Street addresses that look residential were deliberately left out of this output.
Scores are relative to this batch of small East Brunswick home-services firms, not to the wider market.
data_gaps: No Google Business Profile data (claimed status, categories, photos, rating) could be verified for any business; Google Search/Maps hit a CAPTCHA wall.

All Handyman Services, Cazza Construction, Nathans Home Improvement, Curb Appeal NJ and Basic Chimney Service have no owned website found, so their agent-readiness scores rest on absence of evidence rather than on inspection.

bigbhandyman.com belongs to a Winona, Minnesota handyman and nathanshomeimprovement.com appears to be an unrelated Montana company - judged unrelated by page content (inference, not confirmed with the owners).
hellocurbappeal.com ('The Curb Appeal Co') sells realtor curb-appeal packages and does not show (732) 510-0377, so it was treated as a different business (inference).

Navarro Pressure Washing's BBB complaint detail and Victory Junk Removal's BBB rating could not be opened (403); the 'not accredited, C rating, unanswered complaint' point for Navarro comes from a search summary only.
All Season Chimney's Angi rating (4.8 / 107) also comes from a search summary; the Angi page itself was blocked.
